parameters.style: Stateful visual overrides before the card theme and global knobs.
parameters.onPressed: Handles activation when the component is interactive.
parameters.onLongPress: What a long press on the card does.
parameters.padding: Sets the space between the frame and its content.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader says for the card, over its content's own text.
parameters.dragged: Applies the visual treatment for a dragged item.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
